title: From One Test to a Whole System
kicker: From one test to a whole system
html:
From One Test to a Whole System

One behaviorComponents and the system
Gherkin says what right means before the code existsOnly the acts the state allows; a reason when not
The scenario runs the same way on every changeA kept script replays the same way, with no model
A break goes red, and the gate refuses the commit, even the model’sBuster tampers on purpose; ARTIE takes the right failure path

One test at a time, for components and systems that are themselves right, repeatable and resilient.
say: Here's the shape of all of it. In the middle, one behavior, like the library's renewal policy: a scenario, the right red, the code, green, a gated commit. Around it, the generic components built that way: ARTIE, the gateway that puts HEART in front of a forge, heart-mcp, Buster. Around those, a system. The same three things hold at every ring. Right behavior: only what's allowed, and the right thing when it is. Repeatability: that right behavior, the same way, every time. Resilience: when something breaks or changes, the right failure path, and on we go. Now let's see the outer ring, for real: a release of that library.
